cohort: 7504 women who delivered at De Soysa Hospital for Women in Sri Lanka
finding: Analysis of CS practices according to the WHO Robson classification revealed that Group 3 and Group 1 were the most represented, and major contributors to the CS rate were Groups 5, 1, 2a, and 10, with the most common indications being abnormal cardiotocography, past CS, and labor dystocia.
